title: Framework Engineering integrated-profile incremental-value hypothesis
statement: For bounded analytical-framework tasks, the full FE integration improves downstream correct action and evidence integrity over a feature-, effort-, and documentation-matched composition of established adjacent practices without unacceptable lifecycle cost.
falsification_criteria: preregistered equivalence between FE and the matched adjacent profile
benefits disappear after documentation dose and presentation are matched
FE-specific ablation performs equivalently to full FE
quality gain is outweighed by lifecycle cost or cognitive burden
relationship_to_FEH_001: Operational successor hypothesis for the remaining integrated-profile interpretation.
